I dug into the signals. Quick summary:
- Same device fingerprint token appears on 7 of the 12 records.
- 5 accounts show disposable domains (mailinator, yopmail variants) but display name and company field set to Zephyr-related strings.
- All signups originated from two IPs that resolve to the same cloud provider and have overlapping TTLs; we see identical TCP handshake timestamps in the packet capture Emily attached.
- Our logs show a rapid token-exchange pattern consistent with automated test runs hitting the signup endpoint (very low inter-event timing).

Recommendation: Hold retroactive self-serve credits pending verification. Ask Zephyr to confirm the canonical account and provide SSO audit or a short video of the signup flow. If they can demonstrate corporate SSO or a single owner, we can do a manual grant for the canonical main account.

I'll attach a sanitized log snippet to the Jira ticket INF-4821 for audit.
